basket.law: Keep overlapping saved trades and score them in entry order. Same-time entries use weight, basket order and trade ID. Check each trade’s adverse excursion before booking its full net P&L. Opposite sides are processed as separate saved trades, with no position netting. Funded opening tiers cap the basket targets proportionally, rounded down per member. Combined MAE is an advisory sum of standalone excursions at target size. It does not affect account outcomes and cannot establish the timing or size of an actual combined loss. If excursion evidence is missing, the simulation uses its existing realized-loss proxy and the overlap screen marks the evidence incomplete.

members.risk_basis: MultiCharts modeled OHLC path excursions restricted to entry-through-exit, including entry and realized exit costs once. These are model estimates, not measured tick MAE/MFE or confidence bounds. Opening gaps and cost jumps can overshoot floors; intervening modeled crossings use the threshold price. Unobserved tick gaps, liquidity and queue effects are not reconstructed.
members.session_convention: Common observed CME session labels, including no-trade sessions.

provenance.uncertainty: Conditional Monte Carlo sampling error, not future uncertainty or verified provider parity
